input.quote: the nonbreaching party may terminate this Agreement on written notice at any time following the end of such-thirty (30) day period.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no liquidated damages, penalty, late-payment interest, minimum-shortfall or early-termination fee payable by Corio. Fees (Sections 4.1–4.4, Exhibit B pricing and Exhibit B payment terms) are limited to license, maintenance/support, MarketSite.net access, implementation and revenue-share amounts actually earned, and termination under Section 11.2 triggers no exit or minimum payment — only survival of ongoing payment obligations for continued use and support, which is consideration rather than a penalty. This meets the preferred position (no liquidated damages or penalties payable by the customer), so no redline is warranted. Amounts running the other way (Commerce One's MarketSite transaction revenue share to Corio in Exhibit B and its support obligations in Exhibit C) benefit us and are not flagged.
